book.name: Yohana
book.title: Amangʼana amazomu ga Yeesu Krisito kyeego gakaamirwe na Yohana

content: Yeesu arabhiisaabhya amaguru abhaanabheega bhaaye

Ambe, hano Enyaangi yo Okuhiita yaari ekyaari kuhika, Yeesu akamenya kubha eriibhaga ryaaye rihikiri ryo kutanura mukyaaro kino kugya ku Wiise waabhu. Yeesu yaari abhaseegiri abhaatu bhaaye bhano bhari mukyaaro, kweeki akabhaseega tee obhuteero.
Yeesu na abhaanabheega bhaaye bhakiikara kurya ebhyaakurya bhye engoroobha. Eriibhaga riyo, Seetaani yaari amariri kumukorokoomba Yuuda, omwaana wa Simooni Isikariyoti, okubha amurye omukoonyo Yeesu.
Yeesu akamenya kubha, Wiise amuheeri obhuturo bhwo okubhikaangata ebhigiro bhyoosi. Kweeki akamenya arwiiri ku Taatabhugya, na arakyoora ku Taatabhugya.
Ambe, Yeesu akatiga kurya, akiimeerera, akaruusya omweenda gwaaye gwi igutu, akagega ekitaambaara akakibhoha mukiribhizi.
Akiituruurira amaanzi mukarayi. Ambe, akataanga kubhoogya abhaanabheega bhaaye amaguru no okubhatarikya ne ekitaambaara kino yiibhohiri.
Hano Yeesu yamuhikiiri Simooni Petero, Petero akamubhuurya, “Ee Omukuru, oreenda okuniogya amaguru gaane?”
Yeesu akamukyoora, “Awe otamenyiri bhoono gano nikukora, nawe oragamenyeekererya ibhaga riindi.”
Petero akamubhuurira, “Otakunagya na rumwe okuniisaabhya amaguru gaane!” Yeesu akamukyoora, “Eraabhe nitakukwiisaabhya awe, otakunagya kubha hamwe na neenye.”
Simooni Petero akamubhuurira, “Ee Omukuru, eraabhe niigo, otakuniisaabhya amaguru ageene, nawe na amabhoko gaane hamwe no omutwe gwaane.”
Yeesu akamubhuurira, “Omuutu wuno amariri kwiisaabha, atakweenderwa kwiisaabha kweeki, nawe okwiisaabha amaguru ageene. Wuyo yeeriri kimwe. Na neemwe mweeriri, nawe mutari mwoosi.”
Yeesu yaari amumenyiri wuno araamurye omukoonyo, nikyo ekigirirye yagaambiri, “Mutari mwoosi kubha mweeriri.”
Hano Yeesu yamariri kubhiisaabhya abhaanabheega bhaaye amaguru, akiibhoha omweenda gwaaye, akiikara kweeki hano bhaari bhakurya ebhyaakurya, akabhabhuurya, “Mbe, mumenyiri gano nibhakoreeri emwe?
Emwe muraambirikira enye, ‘Omweegya,’ kweeki muraambirikira, ‘Omukuru.’ Muragaamba obhuheene, kwe ekigirirye enye niigo niri.
Enye, wuno ni Mweegya no Omukuru weenyu, nisaabhirye amaguru geenyu. Egoego na neemwe, mureenderwa mwiisaabhanie amaguru.
Nibheerekirye ekireengyo okubha na neemwe mubhe murakorerana kyeego enye nibhakoreeri emwe.
Ndabhabhuurira obhuheene, omugya atari mukuru kukira omukuru waaye, kweeki wuno akutumwa atari omukuru kukira wuno akumutuma.
Eraabhe murigamenya gayo, ambe hakiriku kubhano mukugakora.

“Nitakugaamba gano kwiiguru emwe bhoosi. Nibhamenyiri abhaatu bhano nibhasoriri kubha abhaanabheega bhaane. Nawe nigaambiri gano okubha gakuunaane gano gakaamirwe mu Makaamo Amahoreeru, ‘Omusaani waane wuno yaari akurya ebhyaakurya hamwe na neenye, yiibharaangwiiri kubha omubhisa waane.’
Ndabhabhuurira gano goosi gakyaari kutuuka, okubha hano garaatuuke, mwiikirirye kubha enye ndiho.
Ndabhabhuurira obhuheene, omuutu wowoosi wuno akumusuungʼaana wuno nimutumiri, ansuungʼaaniri na neenye. Egoego, wuno akunisuungʼaana enye, aramusuungʼaana Taata wuno anirageenie.”
Yeesu aragaamba iguru ya wuno araamurye omukoonyo
Hano Yeesu yamariri kugaamba gayo, akahoobha mukoro yaaye, akagaamba mwaasi, “Ndabhabhuurira obhuheene, owumwe weenyu aranirya omukoonyo.”
Ambe, abhaanabheega bhaaye bhakataanga okwiiroreerera, kwe ekigirirye bhataamenyiri aramugaamba weewi.
Yaari ariho omwaanamweega owumwe, wuno Yeesu yaari amuseegiri bhukongʼu. Ewe yaari yiikeeri haguhi na Yeesu eriibhaga ryo okurya.
Ambe, Simooni Petero akamusimya omwaanamweega wuyo, akamubhuurira, “Mubhuurye Yeesu aramugaamba weewi gati weetu.”
Ambe, omwaanamweega wurya akiiyegeka ku Yeesu, akamubhuurya, “Ee Omukuru, ni weewi?”
Yeesu akamukyoora, “Niwe wuno ndaamukorerye no okumuha ekitinika kyo omukaate.” Ambe, akagega kitinika kyo omukaate akakorya, akamuha Yuuda, omwaana wa Simooni Isikariyoti.
Kituukiro ego hano yamariri okusuungʼaana kitinika kirya kyo omukaate, Seetaani akamusikirira Yuuda. Ambe, Yeesu akamubhuurira, “Gano okweenda kukora, gakore bhwaangu!”
Nawe ataari ariho naabhe wumwe gati wa bhano bhaari kurya wuno akamenyeekererya kwaki Yeesu yaari abhugiri ego.

Abhaandi bhakiiseega Yeesu abhugiri ego, kwo okubha Yuuda niwe yaari omutiimbiriri we esakwa ye eziimbirya. Bhakiiseega kubha Yeesu amubhuuriiri agure bhino bhikweenderwa munyaangi, kasi abhahe abhataka eziimbirya suuhu.
Ambe, hano Yuuda yasuungʼaaniri ekitinika kyo omukaate, akarwa igutu bhwaangu. Ne eriibhaga riyo, bhwaari bhutiku.
Yeesu arabhaha abhaanabheega bhaaye obhuswaagyo obhuhya

Ambe, hano Yuuda yahurukiri igutu, Yeesu akabhabhuurira abhaanabheega bhaaye, “Bhoono obhuguungo bhwaane, enye Omwaana wo Omuutu, bhwiisukiri kurorekana mwaasi. Kweeki bhurarorekana mwaasi obhuguungo bhwa Taatabhugya kuhitira kweenye.
Kyeego bhukurorekana obhuguungo bhwaaye kuhitira kumahokya gaane, ambe neewe Taatabhugya arabheerekya abhaatu obhuguungo bhwaane enye Omwaana wo Omuutu, kweeki arakora bhwaangu.

“Emwe abhaana bhaane, nikyaari ne eriibhaga iguhi kubha neemwe. Murankomya, nawe kyeego niari nibhuuriiri abhakaangati bha Abhayahudi, egoego ndabhabhuurira na neemwe bhoono, hano nkugya enye, emwe mutakunagya kuuza.
Nawe bhoono, ndabhaha obhuswaagyo obhuhya, ndabharagania kubha: Mwiiseege. Kyeego enye nibhaseegiri emwe, egoego na neemwe mwiiseege.
Eraabhe muraseegana, ambe, abhaatu bhoosi bharamenya kubha emwe ni bhaanabheega bhaane.”
Yeesu araroota kubha Petero aramwaanga
Ambe, Simooni Petero akamubhuurya Yeesu, “Ee Omukuru, oragya hayi?” Yeesu akamukyoora, “Ndagya hano awe otakunagya okunituniirira bhoono, nawe oranituniirira ibhaga riindi.”
Petero akamubhuurya, “Ee Omukuru, kwe ekigirirye kiihe nitakunagya kukutuniirira bhoono? Enye ndakwa kwiiguru waazo!”
Yeesu akamukyoora, “Mbe, eheene oriikirirya okukwa iguru waane? Ndakubhuurira obhuheene, hano ekorokoome erabha ekyaari kugaamba, orabha omariri kunianga katatu koosi.”

footnotes.text: Enye ndiho, niigo Taatabhugya akwiimenyeekererya Mwiiragano rye Ekare. Rora Okurwa 3:14; Isaya 43:10-11.
